data.gender_notes: Alisa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic name 'Aaliah' which means 'noble, exalted'. In Arabic, Al- is a prefix meaning 'the' or 'the one'. So Alisa can be interpreted as 'the noble one' or 'the exalted one'. The name Alisa carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alisa usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the qualities of nobility, dignity, and high morals. It is a name for a girl who is expected to uphold these values and be a role model for others.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alisa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
